# Bionial Lifesciences
> WHO-GMP certified nutraceutical and Ayurvedic contract manufacturer in Mohali, Punjab, India. 218+ formulations. 50+ patented APIs. MOQ from 1,000 units. 30-day delivery.

## Services
- [Contract Manufacturing](https://bioniallife.com/services/contract-manufacturing/): Full-service nutraceutical contract manufacturing with NDA, formulation, regulatory support.
- [Private Label](https://bioniallife.com/services/private-label/): 218+ ready-to-market formulations with custom branding and FSSAI labeling.
- [Third-Party Manufacturing](https://bioniallife.com/services/third-party-manufacturing/): Flexible 3P manufacturing for established pharma and D2C brands.
- [Custom Formulation](https://bioniallife.com/services/custom-formulation/): In-house R&D develops bespoke formulas. Bench sample in 10 days.

## Dosage Forms
Capsules (HPMC/gelatin), Softgels (enteric/standard), Tablets (film/SR/ER), Syrups and Suspensions, Powders and Sachets (1-20g), Ayurvedic (Churna/Kwath/Vati/Arishta)

## Patented Ingredients (50+ total)
- KSM-66 Ashwagandha (Ixoreal Biomed): Root-only, 5% withanolides, 48 RCTs
- Kaneka Ubiquinol CoQ10 (Kaneka): Active reduced CoQ10, 85+ human trials
- BioPerine (Sabinsa): 95% piperine, bioavailability enhancer, 63 clinical studies
- LactoSpore (Sabinsa): Bacillus coagulans MTCC 5856, GRAS approved, shelf-stable
- BacoMind (Natural Remedies): Standardised bacopa, 9 bioactives, memory and cognition
- Cognizin Citicoline (Kyowa Hakko): Brain energy and focus, FDA GRAS
- Carnipure L-Carnitine (Lonza): Pharmaceutical grade L-carnitine L-tartrate
- FloraGLO Lutein (Kemin): Free-form lutein, macular pigment support
